I don’t have a live API call available in this environment, so I can’t “fetch” the data for you in real‑time.  
However, I can give you a reliable, manually‑compiled list of the **federal holidays that create long weekends in Canada for 2023**.  
(Keep in mind that provincial/territorial holidays can add or shift some dates, so you’ll want to double‑check the specific province(s) you’re interested in.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span (Typical) |
|-------------|---------|-------------|-----------------------------|
| Jan 1 | New Year’s Day | Sunday | Jan 1–3 (Sunday–Tuesday) |
| Feb 20 | Family Day (Alberta, BC, NB, ON, PEI, SK) | Monday | Feb 18–20 (Saturday–Monday) |
| Apr 7 | Good Friday | Friday | Apr 7–9 (Friday–Sunday) |
| May 22 | Victoria Day | Monday | May 20–22 (Saturday–Monday) |
| Jul 1 | Canada Day | Saturday | Jul 1–3 (Saturday–Monday) |
| Sep 4 | Labour Day | Monday | Sep 2–4 (Saturday–Monday) |
| Oct 9 | Thanksgiving | Monday | Oct 7–9 (Saturday–Monday) |
| Nov 11 | Remembrance Day | Monday | Nov 9–11 (Saturday–Monday) |
| Dec 25 | Christmas Day | Monday | Dec 23–25 (Saturday–Monday) |
| Dec 26 | Boxing Day | Tuesday | Dec 26–28 (Tuesday–Thursday) |

### How to Use This List

1. **Add to Calendar** – Import the dates into your holiday‑planning app as events or reminders.
2. **Adjust for Province** – If you’re planning for a specific province, add any additional provincial holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, Heritage Day in Saskatchewan, etc.).
3. **Check Observance Rules** – Some holidays that fall on a weekend may be observed on the following weekday (e.g., if a holiday falls on a Sunday, the next Monday may be a paid day off). Verify with local employment regulations.

### Quick Reference (by Month)

- **January** – New Year’s Day (long weekend)
- **February** – Family Day (in most provinces)
- **April** – Good Friday (long weekend)
- **May** – Victoria Day (long weekend)
- **July** – Canada Day (long weekend)
- **September** – Labour Day (long weekend)
- **October** – Thanksgiving (long weekend)
- **November** – Remembrance Day (long weekend)
- **December** – Christmas & Boxing Day (two consecutive long weekends)

Feel free to let me know if you’d like a more detailed breakdown for a particular province or if you need help formatting these dates for your app!
